title: Co-exposure to methylmercury and inorganic arsenic in baby rice cereals and rice-containing teething biscuits
authors: Rothenberg SE; Jackson BP; McCalla G; Donohue A; Emmons AM
abstract_snippet: Rice baby cereals and teething biscuits: MeHg and iAs measured in 36 rice cereals and 8 teething biscuits. Rice teething biscuits 92x higher MeHg than wheat/oat; iAs in 2 brands exceeded 100 ng/g.
notes: PMC5661960 exists but PDF returns HTML login redirect; highly relevant teething biscuit iAs+MeHg paper

title: A Narrative Review of Toxic Heavy Metal Content of Infant and Toddler Foods and Evaluation of United States Policy
abstract_snippet: Excessive exposure to inorganic contaminants through ingestion of foods such as those commonly referred to as heavy metals may cause cancer and other non-cancerous adverse effects. Infants and young children.
notes: US policy review covering infant and toddler snack food heavy metal data

authors: Lorenz S. Neuwirth; Ericka Cabanãs; Patrick Cadet

authors: Anita Mielech; Anna Puścion-Jakubik; Katarzyna Socha
abstract_snippet: Infants and toddlers are highly sensitive to contaminants in food. Chronic exposure can lead to developmental delays disorders of the nervous urinary and immune systems.
notes: Risk contamination review for infant/toddler foods including snacks; Nutrients 2021

title: Widespread occurrence of dimethylmonothioarsenate (DMMTA) in rice cakes: Effects of puffing and storage
authors: Andrea E. Colina Blanco; Alejandra Higa Mori; Britta Planer-Friedrich

title: Elemental composition of toxic and essential elements in rice-based baby foods from the United States and other countries: A probabilistic risk analysis

title: Association of Rice and Rice-Product Consumption With Arsenic Exposure Early in Life
authors: Margaret R. Karagas; Tracy Punshon; Vicki Sayarath; Brian P. Jackson
abstract_snippet: 759 infants: rice snacks contained 36-568 ng/g As and 5-201 ng/g iAs. 32.6% of 12-month infants ate rice snacks. Urinary As higher in rice snack consumers vs non-consumers.
notes: JAMA PDF URL returns 403; PMC5215769 EuropePMC inaccessible; landmark infant rice snack arsenic paper

notes: Korean infant rice snack iAs survey with EU ML comparison; first Korean report on infant snack iAs levels
